content: Nafcillin reduces the plasma levels or therapeutic effects of irinotecan by inducing hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzyme metabolism. It is recommended to avoid coadministration or consider alternative drugs. Nafcillin decreases the levels or efficacy of liposomal irinotecan through its effect on CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the plasma levels or effects of istradefylline by enhancing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inducers should not be coadministered with istradefylline. Nafcillin lowers the levels or effects of ivabradine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Moderate CYP3A4 inducers should also be avoided with ivabradine. Nafcillin decreases the plasma levels of ivacaftor by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inducers significantly reduce systemic exposure to ivacaftor (approximately ninefold), and coadministration should be avoided. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of ivosidenib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inducers decrease ivosidenib plasma concentrations. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of ixazomib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inducers reduce ixazomib Cmax by 54% and AUC by 74%. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of larotrectinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers is unavoidable, double the larotrectinib dose. Resume the prior dose after discontinuing the inducer for 3–5 half-lives. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of lefamulin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers should not be coadministered unless the benefits outweigh the risks. Monitor for reduced efficacy. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of lemborexant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of leniolisib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of lovastatin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Coadministration is contraindicated. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of lumateperone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of lurbinectedin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of macimorelin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers may lead to false-positive test results. Discontinue the inducer and allow for sufficient washout time before testing. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of macitentan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inducers should not be coadministered with macitentan. Nafcillin decreases the efficacy of oral microbiota products due to pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Oral microbiota products contain bacterial spores, and antibacterial agents may reduce their efficacy. Complete antibiotic regimens 2–4 days before initiating oral microbiota therapy. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of midostaurin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inducers may decrease midostaurin concentrations, leading to reduced efficacy. Minocycline reduces the efficacy of nafcillin through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Bacteriostatic antibiotics may interfere with the bactericidal actions of penicillins. Nafcillin and mycophenolate increase each other's levels by reducing renal clearance. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of neratinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers should not be coadministered with neratinib. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of netupitant/palonosetron by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Netupitant is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4, and its use should be avoided in patients chronically using strong CYP3A4 inducers. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of nirogacestat by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of olaparib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with moderate CYP3A4 inducers is unavoidable, monitor for reduced efficacy of olaparib. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of olutasidenib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers reduce olutasidenib plasma concentrations and efficacy. Omadacycline reduces the efficacy of nafcillin through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Tetracyclines may interfere with the bactericidal action of penicillins. Monitor for reduced therapeutic effects of penicillins if used concomitantly with a tetracycline. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of omaveloxolone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of osimertinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inducers should not be coadministered with osimertinib. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of palovarotene by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of pemigatinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of perampanel by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of pexidartinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of pirtobrutinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, increase the pirtobrutinib dose to 300 mg daily (if the dose is 200 mg daily) or increase the dose by 50 mg (if the current dose is 50 mg or 100 mg daily). Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of pomalidomide by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of ponatinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug unless the benefits outweigh the risks of ponatinib underexposure. Monitor for signs of reduced efficacy. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of pralsetinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, double the pralsetinib dose starting on Day 7 of coadministration with a strong CYP3A4 inducer. Resume the previous dose after discontinuing the inducer for at least 14 days. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of praziquantel by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of pretomanid by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Pretomanid is a CYP3A4 substrate, and coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers should be avoided. Nafcillin and probenecid increase each other's levels by reducing renal clearance. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of quizartinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of ranolazine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Coadministration is contraindicated. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of repotrectinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of rimegepant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of ripretinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Coadministration with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor reduces systemic exposure to ripretinib and its active metabolite (DP-5439), potentially decreasing the risk of adverse reactions. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of rolapitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Long-term coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers may significantly reduce rolapitant efficacy. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of romidepsin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inducers should be avoided if possible. Sarecycline reduces the efficacy of nafcillin through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Tetracyclines may interfere with the bactericidal action of penicillins. Monitor for reduced therapeutic effects of penicillins if used concomitantly with a tetracycline. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of selpercatinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of selumetinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of sildenafil by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Potent CYP3A4 inducers are expected to cause substantial decreases in sildenafil plasma levels. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of silodosin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Coadministration is contraindicated. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of simvastatin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Coadministration is contraindicated. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of siponimod by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Coadministration with moderate CYP2C9 plus moderate or strong CYP3A4 inducers is not recommended. Similarly, coadministration with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inducers alone is not recommended for patients with CYP2C9 1/3 and 2/3 genotypes. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of sirolimus by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Coadministration is contraindicated. Nafcillin increases the levels or effects of sofosbuvir/velpatasvir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Velpatasvir is a substrate of CYP2B6, CYP2C8, and CYP3A4. Drugs that are moderate-to-potent inducers of these enzymes may significantly decrease velpatasvir plasma concentrations, potentially reducing therapeutic efficacy. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of sonidegib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers should not be coadministered with sonidegib. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of sotorasib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of stiripentol by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers is unavoidable, increase the stiripentol dose. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of tazemetostat by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Tetracycline reduces the efficacy of nafcillin through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of tezacaftor by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of tivozanib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of tolvaptan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Coadministration is contraindicated. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of trabectedin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of tucatinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the efficacy of the live typhoid vaccine through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Coadministration is contraindicated. Wait until antibiotic therapy is complete before administering live bacterial vaccines. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of ubrogepant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of upadacitinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inducers should not be coadministered with upadacitinib. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of velpatasvir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of venetoclax by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers should not be coadministered with venetoclax. Consider alternative treatments with agents that have less CYP3A induction. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of voclosporin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of vonoprazan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of vorapaxar by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of voxilaprevir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of zanubrutinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug.
